title: Temporal Fusion Transformer
description: Deep learning model combining self-attention with recurrent networks for multi-horizon forecasting.
name: Temporal Fusion Transformer
summary: The Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) is an attention-based deep learning architecture for multi-horizon time series forecasting. It integrates recurrent layers for local processing with self-attention for long-term dependencies, outputting quantile forecasts.
use_when: Performing multi-horizon forecasting on multivariate sequences with static and dynamic variables.
avoid_when: Working with short univariate time series where simple statistical baselines like ARIMA suffice.
pros: Supports multi-horizon forecasting with dynamic time-varying inputs.
Outputs quantile predictions enabling probabilistic risk calculations.
Natively models static metadata covariates alongside sequence variables.
cons: Extremely high computational footprint compared to ARIMA.
Requires substantial data preparation and feature alignment.
Highly sensitive to hyperparameter setups, requiring extensive tuning.

key_hyperparams.name: hidden_state_size
key_hyperparams.note: Dimensionality of recurrent states and attention heads. Limits capacity if small.
